subject: Re: Evergreen Health — collections triggers & interim credit umbrella (proposal)
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Collections triggers & interim credit request

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Quick note from Evergreen Finance — December liquidity is tighter than expected after a delayed receivables run. We want to avoid disrupting the pilot data ingest next month, so would like to discuss pushing our standard Net30 to Net60 for invoices issued in Dec/Jan, and request a temporary credit umbrella to smooth cashflow (~$150k ceiling).

Specifically:
- Can Redwood accept Net60 for invoices dated Dec 2026 and Jan 2027?
- In return we can sign a short-term amendment (30–90 days) and propose milestone-based collections (partial upfront + remainder on 30/60 days).
- We can provide a Q4 cashflow forecast and a purchase order if helpful (attached).

We appreciate that this is short notice — happy to jump on a 20–30 min call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neal
Director, Finance — Evergreen Health
liam.oneal@evergreenhealth.com

Attachment: Evergreen_Q4_Cashflow_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collections triggers & interim credit request

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and for sending the forecast, that helped.

We can absolutely work with Evergreen here but will need a short-term guardrail framework so it doesn't materially increase our credit exposure. Proposed approach (high level):

1) Interim credit umbrella: Redwood provides a temporary credit facility capped at $125,000 for 90 days. This is tied to an amended SOW — we can issue an amendment with the amount and repayment schedule.

2) Invoice velocity triggers: instead of a flat Net60 for all invoices, invoices will remain Net30 by default but auto-escalate to an accelerated collection cadence when usage or invoice velocity crosses pre-defined thresholds. Example triggers we propose:
   - If monthly consumption > 120% of last three-month average, the next two invoices are accelerated to Net15/Net30 split (30% up front, remainder due 15 days after invoice).
   - If cumulative outstanding > $75k, weekly receivables sweep is initiated until below $50k.

3) Early-pay discount option: 1% discount if payment is made within 10 days for any accelerated invoice.

Attached is a draft term sheet for the interim credit umbrella. If Evergreen agrees in principle, we'll prepare a short DocuSign amendment and a proposed invoice schedule.

Would Marissa/Karthik + Evergreen Finance be available for a quick call Monday morning to lock down thresholds?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Attachment: credit_umbrella_term_sheet.pdf (term sheet, 45KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collections triggers & interim credit request

Thanks Olga — commercial is okay to proceed with the proposed framework but recommends tightening the exposure a bit given Evergreen's historical payment cadence. Proposed commercial compromise:

- Reduce interim credit umbrella to $100k (90 days).
- Move invoices issued in Dec/Jan to a staged cadence: 40% upfront, 30% at 30 days, 30% at 60 days. This keeps some invoice rhythm and reduces our DSO risk.
- Maintain the invoice velocity triggers (120% threshold) and the 1% early-pay discount.

HubSpot deal: HUB-5739 — I'll update the record with the suggested amendment and a proposed Order of Change. Can you confirm if Finance needs any additional collateral (personal guarantee / PO) to approve $100k?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Note: will join Monday call if scheduled.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collections triggers & interim credit request

Looping in a short risk checklist from Finance / Credit:

- Verified Evergreen's entity VAT registration and outstanding tax reconciliations for Q3 — we need a copy of their VAT filings for our records before finalizing the umbrella.
- Require a PO or signed purchase order acknowledgement for the amended SOW for the $100k umbrella.
- If payment aging exceeds 45 days on more than 2 invoices in a rolling 6-month window, the facility is revoked and invoices revert to standard Net30 with collection holdbacks.
- Recommend adding a monthly reporting cadence (simple CSV) from Evergreen with consumption and cashflow position while the umbrella is active.

I attached an updated term sheet that adds the VAT evidence clause and the PO requirement. If Evergreen can provide the VAT evidence + PO, Finance is comfortable with the $100k ceiling and staged cadence.

-Karthik
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference (acting)
karthik@redwood.com

Attachment: credit_umbrella_term_sheet.pdf (updated, 48KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collections triggers & interim credit request

Liam — appreciate the quick engagement last week. Summary and next steps as agreed: 

1) Interim credit umbrella: $100,000 for 90 days (Dec 19, 2026 — Mar 19, 2027).
2) Invoicing cadence for Dec/Jan: staged schedule — 40% upfront, 30% at 30 days, 30% at 60 days.
3) Invoice velocity triggers: 120% consumption threshold triggers accelerated split (30% up front / remainder due 15 days after invoice) and potential weekly sweep if cumulative outstanding > $75k.
4) Required items from Evergreen: signed PO or PO acknowledgement for amended SOW, and VAT registration evidence (Q3 filing or equivalent).
5) Early-pay discount: 1% if payment clears within 10 days on accelerated invoices.

I've attached the proposed invoice schedule (Evergreen_Proposed_Schedule_v2.xlsx) and created a short amendment for signature. Please review and sign the DocuSign amendment here: https://www.docusign.com/link/EVG-AMEND-5739

If you can get the PO and VAT evidence over before Monday we can issue the first staged invoice on Dec 22. Otherwise we'll aim for Jan 4 start.

Thanks again — open to a quick call Monday morning if you want to walk through the schedule.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

Attachments: Evergreen_Proposed_Schedule_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 36KB); credit_umbrella_term_sheet.pdf (updated)
